_설명: 매회 거의 같은 장면은 한 번만 그리고 돌려 쓴다. image-prompts.json 컷에 "stock": "이름"을 쓰면 그 그림을 복사해 쓴다(API 호출 없음). 그림 파일이 아직 없으면 아래 prompt로 딱 한 번 그려 이 폴더에 저장한다.

pika-intro-a.prompt: Vertical panel. Pika jumps into view with a big happy grin, tiny yellow sparks around its lightning antenna, on a bright radiating yellow burst background typical of comics. Pika is in the lower two-thirds; upper third is the plain burst background.

pika-intro-b.prompt: Vertical panel. Pika pops up from below with one paw raised as if starting an explanation, winking, small electric sparks around its lightning antenna, on a bright sky-blue radiating comic burst background. Pika is in the lower two-thirds; upper third is the plain burst background.

pika-intro-c.prompt: Vertical panel. Pika holds a small magnifying glass and looks curious and excited, little stars around it, on a soft mint-green radiating comic burst background. Pika is in the lower two-thirds; upper third is the plain burst background.

ending-a.prompt: Celebration scene in front of a bright school playground at golden afternoon light, confetti in the air. Ryan in the lower left raises both arms happily, Aiden in the lower right smiles and gives a thumbs-up, Pika jumps in the lower middle. Leave a large empty area in the center of the image for a card that will be added later. Upper third is plain warm sky.

ending-b.prompt: Celebration scene in a cozy living room with a big window, paper streamers, soft evening light. Ryan in the lower left cheers with a fist up, Aiden in the lower right claps and smiles, Pika floats in the lower middle with sparkles. Leave a large empty area in the center of the image for a card that will be added later. Upper third is a plain light wall.

ending-c.prompt: Celebration scene on a green park lawn under a clear blue sky with a few balloons. Ryan in the lower left jumps with both arms up, Aiden in the lower right does a peace sign, Pika bounces in the lower middle. Leave a large empty area in the center of the image for a card that will be added later. Upper third is plain blue sky.
